name: MiniMax Agent
desc: MiniMax 通用智能体构建平台
desc_zh: MiniMax 通用智能体构建平台
solves: Building an agent that runs on its own means choosing the models, writing the orchestration and handling failures. The platform ships all of that already configured.
solves_zh: 从零搭一个能自己跑起来的智能体，要自己选模型、写编排、兜异常。平台把这些配好直接用。
best_for: When you want to ship a general-purpose agent without building the runtime yourself.
best_for_zh: 你要上线一个通用智能体，但不想自己搭运行时。
